summary: A tail factor typed on any average row in a DFM's Ratios tab is now kept, as in ResQ, instead of being reset to 1 on computed averages such as Volume - all.
details: The tail cell of every average row is now an input: select it, type the factor, and press Enter.
A DFM imported from ResQ keeps the tail ResQ has on a computed average row, so its ultimates match ResQ's.
